g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: $ uvx seo-desk audit example.com
SEO Desk audit: https://example.com (2026-10-26)
Crawled 1 page from the homepage and its links (no sitemap found)
SEO 60 pages without errors 100 · clean on-page tags 0
AEO 0 question headings 0 · answer-first 0 · FAQ schema 0 · tables or lists 0
GEO 42 AI crawlers allowed 100 · llms files 0 · structured data 0
(SEO is technical and on-page only. Add --keyword with SERPER_API_KEY set for Google rank checks.)
AI crawlers
allowed: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot,
Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot
/llms.txt MISSING (404) /llms-full.txt MISSING (404)
Quick wins
1. Publish a sitemap (/sitemap.xml) and name it in robots.txt (`Sitemap: https://.../sitemap.xml`):
search engines and this audit found pages only through links.
2. Add /llms.txt: a short Markdown map of the site for AI assistants (see https://llmstxt.org).
3. No pages carry structured data: add JSON-LD (Organization on the home page, Article on posts,
Product or SoftwareApplication on product pages).
4. No content pages have question headings: phrase some H2s as the questions people ask (What is...,
How do I...).
5. No content pages open a question heading with a direct answer: put a 25-90 word answer straight
under each question heading, the passage answer engines quote.
6. Write a meta description (70-160 characters) for each page without one (1 page, e.g. /).
7. Give each page one <h1> that says what it's about (1 page, e.g. /).
8. Add a canonical link to each page (1 page, e.g. /).
Issues
1 warn pages without a meta description e.g. /
1 warn pages without a canonical link e.g. /
1 warn pages without an <h1> e.g. /
1 warn pages under 300 words e.g. /
Notes
- no sitemap found (robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-index.xml, /sitemap_index.xml); crawled the
homepage and the pages it links to
